subject: [ERROR] True fault on Life-Support - L09725
body:
Sofia Lindqvist, log L09725 is a TRUE fault (risk 99%).
Why: Wrong module: NINE says 'Notice-Bus' but the log is from Life-Support; Quoted value 21.16 != real reading 24.44; Reading 24.44 is 1.7 std from the Life-Support normal; Calm tone ('all is well') on a ERROR log
Recommended: Repair: reading outside nominal window on Life-Support by Life-Support Specialist Sofia Lindqvist.
Slot: 2187-04-15 04:00 to 2187-04-15 04:30
Similar: L02557, L06575, L05972
